letter:
Riverside Medical Practice
14 Example Road, Anytown

21 October 2026

Dear Mr Okafor,

Thank you for coming to see me on 14/10/2026 about your blood pressure readings.

As we discussed, I have started you on Amlodipine 5mg, to be taken once a day in the morning. The pharmacy will have your prescription ready from tomorrow.

Please book a blood test with the practice nurse in a few weeks' time, so we can check your kidney function.

If you notice swelling in your ankles, please let the surgery know.

Yours sincerely,

Dr A. Mensah
General Practitioner
